title: Playboy March 1989 La Toya Jackson Tom Hanks Complete w/ Centerfold
condition_description: Complete w/ centerfold. Front cover clean and glossy. Back cover has gray smudging and scuff marks, heaviest along the bottom edge (see photo 2). Spine intact.
description:
Playboy magazine, March 1989, original $4.00 cover price. Complete w/ Centerfold.

Cover features: La Toya Jackson - Michael's sister in a Thriller pictorial; Playboy Interview with Tom Hanks; supergroupie Pamela Des Barres; scuba-diving thrills; a drug bust that went bonkers.

Back cover: Canadian Club whisky ad.

Adult collectible - sold to buyers 18+ only. See photos for condition. Ships in a plain, protective mailer.
